notes.title: Patch November 2024
notes.notes:
Changes:

[list]
[*] There is now an extra restart button in the pause menu. Instead of directly restarting when pressing the quick restart button, the pause menu is first opened to prevent accidental restarts.
[*] Minor rebalancing of the hallooween coop mode
[/list]

notes.title: Patch January 2023
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Lower volume for breachlord shots 
[*] Fixed bug in start menu: Level 21 is not selectable any more since it is the breachlord level
[*] Fixed visual bug in final screen: purple tail was too long
[/list]

notes.title: Update November 2022
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Small cooldown added before energy recovers to make the tail less spamable
[*] Spawn rate of tails now depends on existing tail density instead of a fixed timer, which makes it a bit more robust for framerate-issues
[*] Endless Mode is no longer affected by global difficulty setting
[*] Added option to change scaling quality (mostly for fullscreen)
[*] Rebalanced the volume of some sounds
[*] Game does not instantly quit when pressing back/ESC in main menu
[/list]

notes.title: Update October 2022
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Main menu changes
[*] Added hints to main menu, to tell the player when locked content gets available
[*] Rebalancing some of the levels
[*] Fixed some sound isseus (Some sounds were too loud in comparison to others)
[/list]
